correctness.rationale: The signature bijection follows from the published defining conditions; stars-and-bars independently proves all binomial degrees with boundary cases. Boolean Möbius inversion is integral, so the matrix-unit multiplication and resulting block decomposition hold over all coefficient rings. The rank-refined generating series is obtained by an exact word construction and yields the Tribonacci recurrence. Finite exact verification confirms all signatures through n=11 and all Möbius basis product pairs through n=6. General proof, not computation, supports all n.

value.rationale: Block sizes classify all finite-dimensional simple representations and the center dimension over every field, which are natural invariants for the monoid studied in 2022–24. Exact binomial degrees and a rank-refined rational series give a complete, useful representation-theoretic census for every n rather than an arbitrary finite slice; the Tribonacci pattern is a motivated global structural relation.
